name: matilda-mcp
description: Matilda helps realtors turn Follow Up Boss into a daily action plan. Bring your own API key.
long_description:
Matilda is a local, self-hosted MCP assistant for realtors using Follow Up Boss. It helps you find leads that need attention, understand contact history, organize pipeline work, and review CRM actions before they happen.

You supply your own Follow Up Boss API key. It stays on your machine and is used to call Follow Up Boss directly. Safe Mode is on by default: delete tools are hidden, while create and update tools remain available and should still be reviewed before execution.

Matilda is an independent community fork and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Follow Up Boss or the upstream project author.

tools.name: listPeople
tools.description: List and filter contacts in your Follow Up Boss account

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Create a task for a contact

tools.name: createNote
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline

tools.name: searchPeopleByTag
tools.description: Find contacts carrying a given tag

fub_api_key.title: Follow Up Boss API Key
fub_api_key.description: Your own API key. In Follow Up Boss go to Admin > API, then create a key. It stays on this machine.

safe_mode.title: Safe Mode
safe_mode.description: Leave on to hide all 24 HTTP DELETE-backed tools (136 of 160 remain). Create and update tools stay enabled. Turn off only if you need delete operations.

fub_system.title: Registered System Name (optional)
fub_system.description: Only needed for endpoints Follow Up Boss marks "Restricted - Registered Systems Only", such as webhooks. Register your own at docs.followupboss.com/reference#identification.

fub_system_key.title: Registered System Key (optional)
fub_system_key.description: The key issued to you with the system name above. Leave blank unless you registered your own system.
